Rita H: Hey folks — TitanCloud reached out to enable ap-northwest-1. Main asks: marketplace entitlement + SKU mapping, initial GPU reserve (25 A100-80), KMS/HSM pattern for in-region keys, and a short coordinated announcement window. Can partnerships + ops + legal advise?
Noel (TitanCloud): Hi all! We can commit 25 A100-80 (tc-a100-80-prod) and allow tc-a10-40 for burst. We'll require HSM-backed keys (CloudHSM or customer HSM). Rotation 90 days OK. Go-live target: 2027-01-18.
Gabe T: Ops  we need exact SKU ids (got them), expected ramp, and a go-live commitment to request quotas. Also what's Titan's lead time for adding capacity if we need more?
Noel (TitanCloud): Lead time ~6 business days for extra reserved commit in that region. Ramp estimate: 5-8 customers first 30 days.
Sonia L: Legal/compliance  we need a compact addendum covering key custody and in-region log residency. I'll draft and aim to have it ready for review by EOD Wed.
Rita H: I'll take the marketplace entitlement form. Draft payload — posting sample for review:
```json
{ "partner":"TitanCloud", "region":"ap-northwest-1", "skus":["tc-a100-80-prod","tc-a10-40-burst"], "reserved_capacity":25, "burst_policy":"a10-only-for-best-effort", "go_live_date":"2027-01-18" }
```
OpsBot: canary-suggested-window=2027-01-10T09:00Z-2027-01-10T13:00Z; notify=#eng-runtime #eng-sre
Gabe T: Canary criteria: p95 < 230ms, sustained throughput 1.4M tokens/hr, fallback to A10 not exceed 20% of traffic. I'll schedule internal canary and a minimal runbook.
MarketplaceBot: marketplace-submission: submission_id=msub-20261220-777; status=review_pending; reviewer=marketplace@titancloud.com
Noel (TitanCloud): We'll run partner-side canary 2027-01-09 and share metrics. Also happy to provide a 2-line marketing blurb once legal okays it.
Sonia L: Uploaded addendum draft to drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/partners/titancloud/ap-nw-addendum-draft. Need Titan legal contact for signature.
Rita H: Timeline proposal: entitlement submitted this week, addendum signed by 2026-12-28, partner canary 01-09, internal canary 01-10, go-live 01-18, announce 02-01 (two-week embargo). Sound reasonable?
Noel (TitanCloud): Sounds good. We'll aim to sign the addendum quickly. Titan legal contact: legal@titancloud.com.
Gabe T: I'll post the runbook checklist shortly. Assignments: Rita entitlement + marketplace follow-up, Sonia legal addendum, Gabe ops/runbook & canaries, Noel partner coordination.
Rita H: Thanks team. If anything blocks, flag here and I'll escalate. :rocket:
